subject.title: ci(cloudflare): deploy crawl-remote from protected ClawSweeper environment

question: Should ClawSweeper become the protected production deployment authority for crawl-remote under this single-operator, forward-migration, Worker-rollback design?
rationale: Automated review can assess the controls, but it cannot authorize production credential custody, cross-repository operational ownership, the named-operator restriction, or the irreversible migration recovery policy.

options.title: Approve reconstructed cutover
options.body: Port the reviewed controls to current main, revalidate them, merge the companion retirement in order, provision the protected environment, and supervise the first dormant rollout.

options.title: Revise authority model
options.body: Keep the PR open but paused while owners define a different operator set, credential boundary, or recovery contract.

options.title: Retain service ownership
options.body: Do not activate this deployment path and leave production mutation authority in crawl-remote.

recommendation.title: Approve reconstructed cutover
recommendation.body: Port the reviewed controls to current main, revalidate them, merge the companion retirement in order, provision the protected environment, and supervise the first dormant rollout.

likelyOwner.reason: He designed and implemented the complete authority-transfer and migration-compatibility workflow and is the strongest evidence-backed owner for the decision.
